defects.summary: The status line says 'deviations 50–58', but the list it points to goes to 59, so the status line is not true.

S5.5.2–S5.5.4 never show that the home held its junction during the turn (S5.6.7 does), so their recorder-not-invoked check has no proof it could fire; S5.5.1 also checks 'scratch and canary unchanged' only indirectly, through an empty failureKind.
The Scope/Scopes disposer and the StandIn seam setup are copied into both new test classes, although AKimiConsultationScenarioTests already has the same helper. They are not reused.

The new TheVectorsCoverKimi does the same job as the existing TheVectorsActuallyLoaded_AndCoverEveryPairOfTheTable, which the spec names as S5.6.2. Also, the Records doc comment still lists only the first five runtimes and vibe, not the new Kimi record.

summary: All 12 scenarios are present and pass, and every Decision is met as written: the kimi planner arm (Snapshot with both roots for disk, Scratch for none, no flags), unconfined none and disk rows with the cells the spec names, an unmeasured web row that is refused naming RESULTS_kimi_confinement.md, a refusal of any Leading or Flags in KimiConsultant, kimi added to the hand-written Runtimes list, and the vectors and generated table with their checks green. The findings are minor: a status line that miscounts the deviations, copied test helpers plus one redundant test, and check tests whose junction-first recorder is not shown to have a live junction to meet.
